**Job Req ID:** 50365
  
  

**Location:**  

Mumbai, Maharashtra, IN
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Function:** Marketing/Digital
  
  

**About:**  

Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on\-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
  
  

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
  
  

VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
  
  

VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
  
  

Job Purpose
  
  

The Corp Function Product Delivery Lead governs end\-to\-end digital delivery for digital assets used by corporate functions including HR and applications for employees like R\&R and employee experience portal. This role orchestrates cross\-functional teams of designers, developers, analytics experts, AI engineers and QA specialists to deliver business features and digital journeys that enhance user experience and drive adoption. The leader sets delivery excellence standards, ensures application stability, and drives continuous improvement across the corporate function digital ecosystem.
  
  

Key Responsibilities and reskilling as applicable
  
  

**Product Strategy \& End\-to\-End Ownership:** Serve as the key strategist and execution partner for Corporate Function apps, owning the product roadmap and end\-to\-end delivery of digital features aligned with business vision leveraging AI and adhering to strict timelines.
  
**Digital Transformation \& Process Optimization:** Execute the complete digitization of business processes or customer journeys, lead the integration and effective use of AI\-driven tools and technologies to reduce operational friction and modernize legacy workflows.
  
**Adoption \& Performance Metrics:** Drive continuous KPI improvements for high\-impact capabilities, including digital adoption metrics and secure adoption of AI
  
**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Drive alignment across a diverse network of internal and external teams—including functional product managers, IT, AI , engineering, UI/UX design, analytics, sales, marketing, and external support agencies.
  
**Agile Pipeline \& Demand Governance:** Govern the delivery pipeline, utilizing stakeholder\-driven prioritization, and coordinating with implementation teams for effective resource planning.
  
**Rigorous Quality Engineering:** Enforce strict SIT/UAT testing standards to guarantee a \< 1% defect escape rate while ensuring rapid issue resolution ahead of production rollouts.
  
**Operations \& Incident Management:** Lead PAN\-India application availability and stability by managing critical S1/S2 incidents, conducting root\-cause resolution, and overseeing post\-production support.
  
**Launch \& Release Management:** Maintain ultimate accountability for all development and operations activities, spanning partner coordination, pre\-production readiness, and seamless enterprisewide product deployments.
  
**Effective use of AI tools:** Leverage AI tools to automate workflows, basic prompt engineering, streamlining internal processes
  
  

Technical/ Functional Competencies
  
  

Digital Journey Mapping and Optimisation
  
AI\-enabled process optimization and automation, Knowledge of AI/ML tools
  
Agile Product Delivery Management
  
Product Lifecycle Management
  
Quality Assurance and Testing Standards
  
Basic Prompt Engineering and AI landscape understanding
  
  

Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies
  
  

Stakeholder Management
  
Analytical Thinking
  
Cross\-functional Team Leadership
  
Customer Focus
  
  

Leadership Competencies
  
  

Cross\-functional Leadership
  
Team Coaching
  
Change Leadership
  
  

Qualifications \& Experience
  
  

Minimum Education Qualification
  
  

B.E./B.Tech and MBA or equivalent
  
  

Years of working experience
  
  

5\-6 years total with at least 2 years in agile digital product delivery and cross\-functional team leadership
  
  

Working Relationship
  
  

Internal Stakeholders
  
  

Product and Business leads across Corporate Functions
  
Engineering and QA teams
  
Analytics and Data teams
  
Digital Delivery Governance team
  
AI Governance Team
  
HR for people management and learning
  
  

External Stakeholders
  
  

Technology vendors and SI partners
  
Design and UX agencies
  
QA and Testing partners
  
Customer feedback and research firms
  
  

Vodafone Idea Limited (formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
  
An Aditya Birla Group \& Vodafone partnership

Product Manager

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India product team

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad — or Remote (India)

About the Company

A high-growth, venture-backed SaaS company is building its India product team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire. You will own a real product area from day one and ship decisions that customers feel in weeks, not quarters. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will own a slice of the roadmap end to end - from problem discovery through launch and iteration - working closely with design, engineering, and go-to-market to turn customer needs into shipped value.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Roadmap

- Talk to customers, study usage data, and define the problems worth solving
- Own a prioritised roadmap for your area and the reasoning behind it
- Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria

Delivery & Iteration

- Work day to day with design and engineering to ship and refine features
- Define success metrics and track adoption, retention, and impact
- Run launches with marketing, sales, and support

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3 to 7 years in product management, ideally in B2B or SaaS
- A track record of shipping products that moved a metric
- Strong product sense, written communication, and comfort with data
- Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or SQL
- Exposure to building products for global or US customers
- Familiarity with a startup or zero-to-one environment

What We Offer

- A founding product seat with a high-growth SaaS company
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- High ownership and direct influence on the roadmap
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

job_description:
**Technical Product Manager B2B SaaS**

**AskTalos | Remote (India-based) | 3+ Years Experience**

**The Role**

You'll be the bridge between customers and product. Not sitting in isolation writing specsyou'll be in discovery calls with founders, demoing AI voice agents to CXOs, and solving real business problems by showing customers exactly how automation can transform their operations.

This is a customer-facing product role for someone who understands technology deeply but genuinely enjoys translating it into business outcomes. You'll conduct product demonstrations, discover what customers actually need, recommend the right solutions, and own the entire journey from sale to successful implementation.

**About AskTalos (Nevis Software Solutions Pvt Ltd)**

AskTalos is an AI-powered business automation platform for Indian SMBs and SMEs owned by Nevis Software Solutions Pvt Ltd. We help business owners automate their customer communication and sales processes through AI Voice Agents, CRM, WhatsApp automation, chatbots, email workflows, and lead management—so they can scale without scaling headcount.

Our customers are mostly founder-led companies, from real estate and financial services to e-commerce and education. They're busy, they're skeptical of yet another SaaS tool, and they need someone who can show them exactly how we'll solve their problem.

That's you.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Discovery & Demonstrations**

- Conduct product discovery calls with prospects to understand their business challenges, current processes, and automation gaps.
- Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to different industries and use cases (real estate, fintech, e-commerce, education, B2B services, etc.).
- Present solutions with clear ROI—show customers the exact workflow, timeline, and business impact.

**Translate Business Into Product**

- Listen to customer requirements and convert them into clear product workflows, implementation plans, and feature requests.
- Identify what our platform can solve today, what needs configuration, and what feedback to send to our product team.
- Document everything that matters: use cases, customer feedback, gaps, and expansion opportunities.

**Own the Implementation**

- Coordinate with our Sales, Product, Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth, successful implementations.
- Configure solutions, train customers, and support adoption so they actually see the value they were promised.
- Be the voice of the customer internally and the voice of the product externally.

**Grow Accounts & Identify Opportunities**

- Once a customer is live, you'll identify where they can use more of the platform—new modules, integrations, additional automation workflows.
- Recommend expansions based on their actual business needs and evolving challenges.

**Stay Sharp**

- Keep current on product features, AI capabilities, and automation trends so you can confidently speak about what's possible.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation and demo environments.
- Use AI tools to create proposals, workflows, and supporting materials that help close deals and launch implementations.

**Who We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

- 3+ years in B2B SaaS, Product Management, Technical Presales, Solution Consulting, or SaaS Implementation.
- Proven ability to conduct software product demonstrations confidently.
- Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
- Working knowledge of at least one of: CRM, APIs, SaaS integrations, business automation workflows, or customer onboarding.
- Excellent communication skills—you can explain technical concepts to non-technical founders and detail workflows to engineers.
- Comfort working with founders, CXOs, and senior decision-makers (not just department heads).
- Self-directed: you manage multiple customer requirements independently and take ownership end-to-end.

**Nice to Have**

- Experience with AI-powered solutions or AI calling platforms.
- Familiarity with CRM platforms, WhatsApp Business API, chatbots, or email automation.
- Background in marketing automation or lead-management systems.
- Understanding of API integrations and technical implementation workflows.
- Experience with customer onboarding at scale.

**The Right Mindset**

- You're genuinely interested in customer problems, not just closing deals.
- You can balance being consultative with being straightforward about what we can and can't do.
- You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you own multiple moving pieces.
- You see feedback (from customers or the team) as useful input, not criticism.
- You're curious about AI and automation but pragmatic about real-world business needs.

**What You'll Own**

Complete customer journey from initial discovery through successful implementation and adoption.

Product demonstrations for multiple industries and use cases.

Coordination across teams (Sales, Product, Support, Customer Success, Development).

Solution design and configuration for customer requirements.

Customer feedback, feature requests, and product improvement recommendations.

Account expansion opportunities and cross-sell recommendations.

Documentation, demo environments, and team enablement.

**What We Offer**

**Compensation & Benefits**

- Competitive salary up to 8 LPA (negotiable based on experience).
- 100% remote work (Work from Home).
- Flexible working arrangement.

**Growth & Impact**

- Direct exposure to real-world AI, automation, and SaaS implementation projects.
- Work with cutting-edge AI Voice Agent technology and modern automation platforms.
- Opportunity to shape product direction through direct customer feedback.
- Fast-paced, collaborative environment with a lean, high-impact team.
- Chance to build expertise across AI, CRM, automation, and business processes.

**The Work**

- No politics or endless meetings—work focused on outcomes.

job_description:
We are looking for an experienced **AI Product Manager** who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high\-ownership, enterprise\-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting\-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products.


The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.


The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption.
* Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape AI\-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision\-support tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop enterprise applications.
* Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product artifacts such as problem statements, user journeys, PRDs, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and release scope.
* Partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and delivery teams to ensure product intent is translated into practical, scalable solutions.
* Drive workshops, requirement discovery sessions, stakeholder reviews, demos, and alignment discussions with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
* Build lightweight prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and product mock flows using modern AI tools, no\-code/low\-code methods, vibe coding, and basic design/prototyping techniques where useful.
* Help define and refine AI use cases involving agents, orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, and enterprise system integration.
* Maintain a sharp eye for detail across business requirements, product behavior, user experience, and delivery quality.
* Manage client expectations proactively by balancing ambition, technical feasibility, timelines, and delivery realities.
* Support value realization and account growth by identifying follow\-on product opportunities, expansion areas, and innovation pathways within client accounts.
* Contribute to a product and delivery culture that values speed, clarity, experimentation, accountability, and customer impact.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Enterprise AI products and features are clearly defined, well\-prioritized, and shipped with strong adoption potential.
* Clients see you as a credible product partner who understands both business value and execution constraints.
* Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams.
* AI use cases move beyond demos into usable workflows that solve real operational problems.
* Teams make faster, better decisions because product direction, scope, and trade\-offs are well managed.
* Client confidence improves through strong communication, attention to detail, and disciplined expectation management.
* You help create momentum for account expansion by spotting practical product and AI opportunities that clients want to invest in.

  

**Requirements**  

* + 7–14 years of experience in ProApplication formDesign the application form for this role.duct Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Enterprise Software, Digital Products, or related technology roles.
	+ Demonstrated experience working on software products, platforms, or enterprise applications in client\-facing environments.
	+ Good understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, with practical exposure to AI\-enabled product design and delivery.
	+ Exposure to building or shaping **agent\-based / agentic workflows** or AI\-driven assistants/copilots in a product or solution context.
	+ Strong experience in requirements discovery, user story definition, prioritization, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional execution.
	+ Ability to engage confidently with enterprise clients, business users, engineering teams, and senior internal stakeholders.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and present with clarity.
	+ High attention to detail and the ability to manage product quality and client expectations in parallel.
	+ A hands\-on mindset with the willingness to prototype, experiment, and validate ideas quickly rather than rely only on documentation.
	+ Comfort working in ambiguous, fast\-evolving environments where AI capabilities, client needs, and product direction are still being shaped.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Prior experience in a consulting or client advisory environment is highly desirable.
	+ Exposure to enterprise domains and business applications is preferred.
	+ Experience supporting **farming\-led account expansion**, identifying opportunities within existing accounts, or helping grow strategic client relationships is a strong plus.
	+ Background as a Software Engineer or strong technical foundation is preferred.
	+ Familiarity with enterprise workflow systems, platform integrations, business process automation, or complex multi\-stakeholder applications is a plus.
	+ Experience creating basic prototypes independently using AI coding tools, prompt\-based development, wireframing, or lightweight design tools.
	+ Strong educational background from top\-tier institutions is preferred, including **IIMs**, **IITs, BIT Mesra, BITS Pilani, top NITs,** or equivalent institutions.

**Skills and Capability Areas**

* + AI product thinking and practical GenAI application
	+ Agentic workflow understanding and AI feature conceptualization
	+ Enterprise product management and requirements rigor
	+ Client\-facing communication and consulting maturity
	+ Hands\-on prototyping, experimentation, and validation
	+ Cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, UX, and delivery
	+ Strong execution discipline and attention to detail
	+ Commercial awareness and account growth mindset

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* + You are likely to thrive in this role if you are someone who enjoys building in fast\-moving environments, likes solving messy enterprise problems, and can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You are structured but not rigid, hands\-on but not narrow, and client\-focused without losing product depth. You bring ownership, curiosity, and pragmatism. You know how to earn trust in a room, ask the right questions, and turn ambiguity into action.
	+ You should also enjoy working at the frontier of enterprise AI, where the best solutions require not only product thinking and technical awareness, but also judgment, experimentation, and strong partnership with clients and delivery teams.

**Why Join Accellor**


This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping real enterprise AI products, not just internal experiments or slideware. At Accellor, you will work on cutting\-edge AI applications for global clients, solve complex business problems, and build products that matter in real operating environments.

* You will gain exposure to international clients, cross\-functional teams, and high\-impact business contexts. You will have the opportunity to influence both product direction and delivery outcomes, while building deep experience in one of the most important technology shifts underway today.
* For the right candidate, this role offers a strong platform for growth across AI product management, enterprise transformation, consulting, and global client leadership.

**Location / Working Model**


This role is based in **Hyderabad or Bangalore**. Travel may be required based on client and project needs.

**Reporting Structure**


This role reports to the **Head of Global Delivery** and will work closely with leadership across Product, Engineering, Design, Delivery, and Client Engagement.

 **Benefits** **Exciting Projects:** We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

**Collaborative Environment:** You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers.

**Work\-Life Balance:** Accellor prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

**Professional Development:** Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

**Excellent Benefits:** We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonus

Additional Job Description

Join us as an Engineering Manager. At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future, we create it. As an Engineering Manager you will be an innovative Generative AI Engineer to drive adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic flows, focusing on process efficiencies, automation, simplification and risk reduction across enterprise business solutions.

To be a successful Engineering Manager, you should have experience with:

- Own product vision, roadmap, backlog, and value delivery.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and data to improve customer and business outcomes.
- Translate business challenges into AI-enabled product requirements.
- Work closely with stakeholders, engineers, designers, and data scientists to deliver solutions.
- Create user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritisation frameworks.
- Prototype and experiment using AI tools, agents, copilots, and automation platforms.
- Measure product performance, adoption, and business impact.
- Ensure solutions align with governance, security, and Responsible AI principles.
- Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Digital Product Lead.
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, and workflow automation.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Azure AI, or similar platforms.
- Strong commercial mindset with a focus on customer value and business outcomes.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Comfortable working in Agile environments and driving rapid experimentation.

Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued

- Business-first thinker with an AI-native mindset.
- Curious, hands-on, and passionate about emerging technologies.
- Able to bridge strategy, technology, and execution.
- Outcome-focused, pragmatic, and driven by measurable value.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Bangalore.

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities

- Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements. 
- Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
- Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
- Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
- Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
- Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
- Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
- Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
- Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
- Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
- If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
- If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
- OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
- Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
- Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
- Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
- Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
- Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
- Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
- Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
- Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

job_description:
Lead Product Manager- Technical Lead Product Manager-Technical - Agentic AI

Overview
==================

The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.

Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.

Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Programs Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.

This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.

Key Responsibilities

Own strategy and roadmap for AI and agentic capabilities across Payment Performance Intelligence.
Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
Balance the long-term direction of a product with today s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products.
Partner closely with engineering, data science/AI, other platform/COE teams to ensure architecture quality, safety, evaluation, and observability.
Own PRDs, backlog prioritizations, story writing, dependencies, and release planning.
Partner with Customer Experience team to design intuitive, highly relevant features that are of maximum value to clients.
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives
Lead user research, discovery, and experimentation to validate use cases, accuracy, trust, and business impact.
Support go-to-market, and customer enablement through demos, query resolution, documentation, and training.
Build strong cross-functional and stakeholder alignment across global teams.
Mentor and develop junior product managers.

Qualifications / Desired Experiences

Knowledge of Product Development and Management principles
Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements.
Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features.
Designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer.
Excellent execution, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Good to have : AI know how, specifically experience of working on Gen AI chatbot use cases support & delivery
Payments industry experience is a plus

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. job_description:
Product Manager

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India product team

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad — or Remote (India)

About the Company

A high-growth, venture-backed SaaS company is building its India product team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire. You will own a real product area from day one and ship decisions that customers feel in weeks, not quarters. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will own a slice of the roadmap end to end - from problem discovery through launch and iteration - working closely with design, engineering, and go-to-market to turn customer needs into shipped value.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Roadmap

- Talk to customers, study usage data, and define the problems worth solving
- Own a prioritised roadmap for your area and the reasoning behind it
- Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria

Delivery & Iteration

- Work day to day with design and engineering to ship and refine features
- Define success metrics and track adoption, retention, and impact
- Run launches with marketing, sales, and support

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3 to 7 years in product management, ideally in B2B or SaaS
- A track record of shipping products that moved a metric
- Strong product sense, written communication, and comfort with data
- Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or SQL
- Exposure to building products for global or US customers
- Familiarity with a startup or zero-to-one environment

What We Offer

- A founding product seat with a high-growth SaaS company
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- High ownership and direct influence on the roadmap
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Product Manager \- Technical
Overview  

  

MasterCard Data \& Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  

  

* We harness the power of real\-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise

  

* We empower customers to make better data\-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behaviour beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data

  

* We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and more

  

The MasterCard Data \& Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology\-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services.
  

  

This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well\-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long\-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  

  

Product Managers in Data \& Services at Mastercard
  

  

* Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value

  

* Balance the long\-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products

  

* Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams

  

* Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade\-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments

  

* Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs

  

Role  

  

* Own, define and deliver end\-to\-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch

  

* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities

  

* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

  

* Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features

  

* Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives

  

* Oversee timely and high\-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements

  

* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals

  

* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team

  

* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership

  

* Promote internal and external feature adoption

  

* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support

  

* Provide input into product pricing and our go\-to\-market strategy

  

* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  

All About You  

  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions

  

* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred

  

* Analytical, solutions\-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership

  

* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness

  

* Requires minimal supervision/assistance

  

* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self\-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements

  

* Proven track record collaborating in cross\-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients

  

* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

  

* Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience

  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

  

* Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus

  

* Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage

  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

A US-headquartered product company scaling its India product hub

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad — or Remote (India)

About the Company

A US-headquartered product company is scaling its India product hub and has partnered with Flexiple to hire senior talent. You will own a meaningful product line, set its direction, and partner with global leadership on bets that matter. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own strategy and execution for a core product area - setting the vision, shaping the roadmap, and driving outcomes across a cross-functional team while mentoring less experienced PMs.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision

- Own the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for a core product area
- Frame the biggest opportunities using research, data, and market context
- Align stakeholders across product, design, engineering, and leadership

Execution & Outcomes

- Drive discovery and delivery for high-impact initiatives end to end
- Define and own the metrics that prove value to the business
- Coach and unblock other product managers on the team

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 5 to 10 years in product management, with senior ownership of an area
- A record of shipping products at scale and driving measurable outcomes
- Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and data fluency
- Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with US or global teams across time zones
- Background in a product-led or platform business
- Exposure to mentoring or leading a small product pod

What We Offer

- A senior seat with a global product company's India hub
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- Direct work with global leadership and real strategic scope
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

Technical Product Delivery Manager, Global HCM Systems

Summary

Regeneron is looking for an experienced and highly motivated Technical Product Delivery Manager with expertise in various Workday HCM modules in terms of technical solutions and systems/software. This role involves supporting both US and international locations. The ideal candidate should possess skills in Workday HCM, technical solutions, and have a deep understanding of the technical aspects and integrations with boundary applications.

Responsibilities

- Knowledge specific to systems and implementation/support. This includes but is not limited to product design, implementing solutions, in-depth technical knowledge, and integration of the product/software being implemented.
- Responsible for assisting the Product Delivery Manager to resolve incidents, break fixes, progressing enhancement requests using Agile methodologies
- Act as an intermediary between the business and the service provider for managing data to day tickets related to incidents and service requests
- Assist the service delivery team to translate requirements into practical, innovative solutions to serve the needs of the business
- Ensure designs are well documented and socialized with the IT team to achieve alignment on approach and future strategy
- Work closely with all technical teams, including boundary systems, and close gaps quickly to speed up the system development process.
- Ensure completion of unit testing and integration testing including the documentation of unit test plans and evidence of testing
- Conduct quality assurance testing of application and integrations prior to business testing
- Support user acceptance testing for major initiatives, small projects, and enhancements to ensure the final solution meets the business requirements
- Serve as the conduit between IT and the business through which requirements flow and are designed, built and tested

Business Technology Planning

- Build and maintain relationships with assigned teams
- Develop and continually strengthen deep knowledge of HR and Service application technologies and business processes for assigned areas
- Act as a workstream lead to ensure plans that support key process areas meet business requirements now and for the future

Requirements:

- 6+ years of proven HR experience working as a technical lead and experienced systems analyst
- Strong experience with Core HR, processes and supporting cross functional technology platforms
- 4+ years of experience with Workday Integration types including EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Studio, API based, BIRT reports, RAAS, custom and calculated fields, XPATH, XML, and XSLT File Transformation Knowledge.
- 4+ years integrating systems with third-party service vendors
- 4+ years technical foundation experience with Workday Recruiting, HCM (Position Mgmt., Security, MSS/ESS, Onboarding), Compensation, Advanced Compensation
- Experience with Performance, Succession Planning, Learning, Absence, Time Tracking, Payroll, Prism and Extend is a plus
- Experience with ServiceNow/Jira or similar cloud application
- Experience with HR application Beeline and TalentHub is a plus
- Technical expertise with application development to assist with the design and specification development desired
- Experience facilitating, supporting and ensuring traceability with requirements exists during testing phases (SIT); experience using testing tools a plus
- Strong ability to collaborate with senior technologists, to define business processes, implement creative solutions and measure delivery results
- Ability to think analytically, a proactive problem solver
- Ability to creatively and constructively challenge/influence technical designs to ensure simplicity and supportability.
- Collaborative, agile mindset to drive speedy, creative and efficient use of technology and data to drive business value
- High degree of business acumen and urgency to act.
- Capable of translating and presenting technical concepts into practical business terms in both small and large group settings.
- Well organized individual who can prioritize tasks and cut through details to identify units of work needed to complete the project
- Excellent communications skills are essential
- A "get-it-done" attitude; ability to juggle multiple high priority tasks quickly
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
- Bachelors Degree required
- Certification(s) in Workday is a plus

**About us:**  

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.  

  

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.  

  

Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000\+ **stores, distribution centers and headquarters**. Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target.  

  

Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading\-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large\-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas.  

  

Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.  

  

As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day\-to\-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team.  

  

This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi\-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry\-standard, out\-of\-the\-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total\-cost\-of\-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network.  

  

Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset\-health and predictive\-maintenance capabilities.  

  

As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.  

  

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.  

  

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.  

  

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  

  

**About you:*** Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development)
* Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams
* Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture
* Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

Senior Product Manager

A US-headquartered product company scaling its India product hub

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad — or Remote (India)

About the Company

A US-headquartered product company is scaling its India product hub and has partnered with Flexiple to hire senior talent. You will own a meaningful product line, set its direction, and partner with global leadership on bets that matter. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own strategy and execution for a core product area - setting the vision, shaping the roadmap, and driving outcomes across a cross-functional team while mentoring less experienced PMs.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision

- Own the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for a core product area
- Frame the biggest opportunities using research, data, and market context
- Align stakeholders across product, design, engineering, and leadership

Execution & Outcomes

- Drive discovery and delivery for high-impact initiatives end to end
- Define and own the metrics that prove value to the business
- Coach and unblock other product managers on the team

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 5 to 10 years in product management, with senior ownership of an area
- A record of shipping products at scale and driving measurable outcomes
- Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and data fluency
- Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with US or global teams across time zones
- Background in a product-led or platform business
- Exposure to mentoring or leading a small product pod

What We Offer

- A senior seat with a global product company's India hub
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- Direct work with global leadership and real strategic scope
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


The role encompasses a broad range of responsibilities aimed at delivering innovative, high\-quality software consultation solutions across hardware, software, and digital platforms:


**Portfolio Strategy \& Category Ownership in alignment with overall department structure**

* Define and own the multi\-year Consultations strategy, aligned with the company's vision care growth objectives and competitive positioning, explicitly covering In\-Store Consultation categories.
* Establish and maintain the category roadmap, covering device\-agnostic consultation workflows that guide ECPs from anamnesis and measurement inputs to the appropriate consultation pathway and product recommendation, independent of the devices connected to the digital connectivity platform.
* Build on continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and voice\-of\-customer research with ECPs and retail chains to identify white spaces, emerging technology trends, portfolio gaps and unmet needs in guided, measurement\-driven consultation workflows.

**Product development oversight in alignment with overall department structure**

* Provide indirect leadership to product development teams, aligning development priorities with category strategy and working closely with the Product Development team to reinforce the product vision, ensuring portfolio investments deliver competitive, market\-ready solutions.
* Own the business requirements and commercial specifications that inform product development and engineering; represent the market perspective throughout the development lifecycle (concept through launch), ensuring clear and testable requirements are defined in close collaboration with Product Owners.
* Define business and workflow requirements that enable consultation guidance based on consumer anamnesis, device\-sourced measurement data and workflow stage, ensuring the solution can recommend the right consultation path regardless of the measurement devices used in the store.
* Serve as senior sponsor for key development programs within the refraction category, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and timely escalation of risks.
* Champion design\-for\-configurability, total cost of ownership, and regulatory strategy considerations from the earliest stages of development.
* Ensure products are designed for serviceability (ease to install, configure, upgrade), partnering with Service/Operations to incorporate field feedback early.
* Ensure products are designed to be secure, including cyber security and data privacy requirements, working with relevant security/compliance stakeholders across the lifecycle.

**Product lifecycle management in alignment with overall department structure**

* Own the full device lifecycle from concept and market entry through growth, maturity, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Define launch strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and regional teams, including go\-to\-market approach, pricing, positioning, and key opinion leader engagement.
* Monitor post\-launch performance against defined KPIs (revenue, margin, market share, customer satisfaction) and drive corrective actions where needed.
* Continuously validate post\-launch whether the solution improves ECP guidance quality, consultation pathway selection, workflow consistency and consumer conversion across different device setups and store environments.
* Plan and execute product refresh, extension, and phase\-out decisions, managing inventory implications in conjunction with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Team leadership \& people management**

* Directly recruit, develop, and manage a team of Product Managers responsible for product implementation across geographies and customer segments.
* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and build individual development plans that grow product management capability within the team.
* Foster a high\-performance culture grounded in customer focus, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as an indirect leader and integrating force for the extended cross\-functional team – including product development engineers, supply chain managers, regulatory specialists, and clinical affairs – ensuring shared ownership of category outcomes.

**Cross\-functional collaboration \& stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary interface between the Consultations category and global functions including Product Development, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Marketing, and Sales.
* Partner with device, connectivity platform, clinical, workflow and UX stakeholders to ensure measurement data from different in\-store devices can be translated into meaningful consultation guidance for ECPs.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure all Consultation Software Solutions in the portfolio are developed and maintained in compliance with applicable requirements (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 10937, and relevant national standards).
* Collaborate with Clinical Affairs to define clinical evidence requirements and support generation of data that strengthens the clinical and commercial position of the portfolio.
* Present category strategy, portfolio performance, and investment cases to executive leadership and governance bodies.

**Education / Professional Certification**

Preferred level of education (unskilled/vocational training/bachelor/university degree); preferred Institutes if any.


* Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical/scientific discipline; MBA or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 7\- 10 years of progressive experience in product management, portfolio management, or category leadership within medical/ophthalmic devices or vision care.
* Proven track record owning and growing a product portfolio across the full lifecycle (sourcing, development oversight, launch and lifecycle optimization).
* Leadership experience managing Product Managers and influencing senior stakeholders in a global matrix organization.
* International launch experience across multiple geographies (e.g., EMEA, APAC, Americas) is preferred.
* Experience defining or managing digital workflow solutions that use anamnesis and measurement data to support clinical or commercial decision guidance, ideally in device\-agnostic retail or healthcare environments.

**Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics**

* Strong analytical and financial acumen; able to build business cases, manage P\&L\-related metrics and use data to drive decisions.
* Solid understanding of regulatory pathways and quality systems relevant to ophthalmic devices (e.g., FDA 510(k), EU MDR, ISO standards; ISO 13485\).
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management; able to present strategy and performance to senior leadership and engage clinical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of ECP consultation workflows, including how anamnesis, measurement data, device interoperability and workflow context can be translated into guided consultation recommendations.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.

**Preferred experience**

* Direct experience with refraction, centration, visual acuity testing, or ophthalmic diagnostic device categories and consultation software.
* Familiarity with integrated refraction, centration workflow platforms and digital health solutions for eye care professionals.
* Familiarity with device\-agnostic data integration concepts and consultation decision\-support workflows that guide ECPs through the consumer journey from anamnesis to recommendation.
* Experience engaging with eye care professionals (ECPs), optometrists, and ophthalmologists as primary customers or stakeholders.
* International product launch experience across multiple geographies including EMEA, APAC, or Americas.
* Experience in a global matrix organization with cross\-cultural team leadership.

**Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics**

Any Special Knowledge/Skill that is required for the function


* Sets direction with clarity and translates long\-term category ambition into executable plans.: Strategic Vision
* Grounds every decision in a deep understanding of unmet customer and patient needs.: Customer Centricity
* Holds self and others accountable; takes ownership and removes obstacles to deliver outcomes.: Drive for Results
* Builds trust and aligns diverse stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority.: Cross\-Functional Influence
* Invests meaningfully in team capability, coaching and stretching talent across the organization.: Developing Others
* Makes evidence\-based decisions; comfortable with complexity, ambiguity, and market data.: Analytical Rigor
* Experience in delivering projects on time and within budget, optimizing processes for resource efficiency.: Complex Project Management

**Working conditions \& Other Attributes.**

List working conditions, health parameters, any other (legally) required information


* Willingness to travel internationally and work effectively across multiple time zones.
* Hybrid working conditions in line with local policies and business needs.

About BiteSpeed

Hey there! We are a Sequoia-backed SaaS startup building an AI-native Marketing, Support & Sales suite for e-commerce brands.

We're currently working with 3000+ e-commerce brands globally across 50+ countries and are fortunate to have raised $5.5M+ along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal & more backing us.

💡 Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!

Check out more about us here - https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200+ odd 5-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).

We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).

About the Role

Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question: "Can AI solve this?"

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into AI-powered solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.

This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.

What you'll do

- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.

- Translate ambiguous business problems into AI-led solution strategies, figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.

- Own the solutioning process from problem discovery to implementation, working closely with engineering, product and customer-facing teams.

- Design workflows and solutions using LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities to solve real customer problems.

- Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.

- Get hands-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.

- Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the product roadmap, helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one-off solution.

- Build repeatable solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI-led solutioning.

- Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.

What makes you a good fit

- You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out "how would we actually solve this?" rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.

- You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.

- You have 3+ years of experience in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy & operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.

- You are genuinely curious about AI and LLMs and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.

- You are comfortable speaking to enterprise customers and senior stakeholders, understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.

- You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.

- You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and high ownership. There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.

- You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.

Salary and Location

Location: Bangalore

Expected CTC: We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

Our Way Of Life - https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way-Of-Life-At-BiteSpeed-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.

Our Purpose

At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.

Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:-

- Personal Transformation
- Wealth Creation
- Winning Together

Our Values

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.

We have 5 core values:-

- Go Above And Beyond
- Making Things Happen
- Say It Like It Is
- Progress Over Perfection
- Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously

Perks & Benefits

Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning & keep things fun:-

- Health Insurance - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.

- Quarterly Off-sites - Quarterly off-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).

- Cult Fitness Membership - All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.

- Personal Development - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.

- Salary In Advance - Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

How to apply?

If this sounds interesting drop a personal note with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on talent@bitespeed.co.

Know someone who might be a great fit? Refer them to us, if they end up joining we'll send you an Apple Airpods Pro as a gesture of thanks!

For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.
