### Job Summary

Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.

A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.

### Your Impact

You will be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.

- Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
- Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
- Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
- Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
- Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
- Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platforms advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
- Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

### Minimum Qualifications

- 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
- Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
- Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
- Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
- Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
- Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
- Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
- Background in networking, security, or observability products.
- Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
- Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
- Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
- Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

### What Success Looks Like in the First Year

- Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
- The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
- A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
- Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Job Description: Product Owner – Insurance Domain  

  

Position Description  

Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Product Owner \- Insurance
  

Position: Senior/Lead Software Engineer  

Experience: 6 \+ Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: Timing/rotation etc. details  

Main location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore and Hyderabad.  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.  

  

Position Summary  

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner with 6\+ years of overall experience, including strong exposure to the insurance domain and Agile product delivery. The Product Owner will be responsible for translating business needs into clear product requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and working closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineering, quality assurance, and implementation teams to deliver high quality insurance solutions.  

The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of insurance products, rating processes, policy administration, underwriting, and product configuration. Experience with Ratabase will be an added advantage.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

. Own and manage the product backlog in alignment with the product vision, roadmap, client priorities, and business objectives.  

. Work with insurance business stakeholders, subject matter experts, clients, and internal teams to gather, analyze, and document requirements.  

. Convert business requirements into clear and actionable: Epics Features User stories Acceptance criteria Business rules Process flows  

. Prioritize backlog items based on business value, client impact, risk, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and delivery capacity.  

. Ensure user stories are sufficiently refined and ready for sprint planning and development.  

. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, UX, quality assurance, infrastructure, and implementation teams throughout the product development lifecycle.  

. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including: Backlog refinement Sprint planning Daily stand ups Sprint reviews and demonstrations Retrospectives Program Increment planning, where applicable  

. Clarify functional requirements and provide timely decisions to development and testing teams.  

. Define acceptance criteria and review completed features to ensure they meet business and functional expectations.  

. Support functional testing, defect triage, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and production implementation activities.  

. Evaluate defects and enhancement requests based on severity, business impact, and product strategy.  

. Maintain product documentation, requirement traceability, release scope, and stakeholder communication.  

. Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions, and gaps early in the delivery lifecycle and drive them to resolution.  

. Monitor product adoption, quality, client feedback, and delivery outcomes to support continuous improvement.  

. Contribute to product roadmap planning and provide inputs for effort estimation, release planning, and prioritization.  

. Ensure delivered functionality complies with insurance business rules, audit requirements, security standards, and applicable regulations.  

. Stay informed about insurance industry trends, digital transformation, automation, and emerging technologies.  

  



**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Qualifications and Experience  

  

. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Insurance, or a related field.  

. 6\+ years of overall experience in business analysis, product ownership, product management, or software delivery.  

. At least 3 years of experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in an Agile software development environment.  

. Strong experience in the insurance domain, preferably Property and Casualty insurance.  

. Good understanding of one or more of the following: Insurance product configuration Rating and premium calculation Underwriting rules Policy lifecycle Quotes, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and reinstatements Forms and filings Rules, rates, factors, tables, and formulas Policy administration systems  

. Experience creating and managing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs.  

. Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.  

. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent product management platforms.  

. Ability to understand technical concepts, APIs, databases, integrations, application workflows, and non functional requirements.  

. Strong analytical, problem solving, decision making, and prioritization skills.  

. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  

. Ability to work effectively with distributed and cross functional teams.  

. Strong stakeholder management and client facing capabilities.  

  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

  

. Experience with commercial insurance or personal lines products such as: Personal Auto Commercial Auto General Liability Workers' Compensation Businessowners Policy Property Inland Marine Umbrella or Excess Liability  

. Experience working with insurance policy administration or rating platforms.  

. Exposure to Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar insurance technology platforms.  

. Experience supporting client implementations, migrations, upgrades, or production releases.  

. Knowledge of insurance regulatory and bureau filings, including ISO, NCCI, or state specific requirements.  

. Product Owner or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager PMI Agile Certified Practitioner  

. Exposure to AI assisted product delivery, requirements analysis, automation, or software development tools.  

  

  

Key Competencies  

  

. Product vision and ownership  

. Insurance domain expertise  

. Business and systems analysis  

. Backlog management and prioritization  

. Requirements elicitation and documentation  

. Stakeholder and client management  

. Agile product delivery  

. Decision making and problem solving  

. Cross functional collaboration  

. Release and dependency management  

. Quality and client outcome focus  

  

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Product Manager

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India product team

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad — or Remote (India)

About the Company

A high-growth, venture-backed SaaS company is building its India product team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire. You will own a real product area from day one and ship decisions that customers feel in weeks, not quarters. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will own a slice of the roadmap end to end - from problem discovery through launch and iteration - working closely with design, engineering, and go-to-market to turn customer needs into shipped value.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Roadmap

- Talk to customers, study usage data, and define the problems worth solving
- Own a prioritised roadmap for your area and the reasoning behind it
- Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria

Delivery & Iteration

- Work day to day with design and engineering to ship and refine features
- Define success metrics and track adoption, retention, and impact
- Run launches with marketing, sales, and support

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3 to 7 years in product management, ideally in B2B or SaaS
- A track record of shipping products that moved a metric
- Strong product sense, written communication, and comfort with data
- Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or SQL
- Exposure to building products for global or US customers
- Familiarity with a startup or zero-to-one environment

What We Offer

- A founding product seat with a high-growth SaaS company
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- High ownership and direct influence on the roadmap
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit
